input: Story segments in program order (Ton/Off, clip, program and source frames, source channel for A1 chosen on the Wrap segment) with their covers (source channel for A2), the program timebase, the project audio.channels as output layout, and a resolver that gives the saved media facts of a clip (QNC media URI, duration, timebase, video and audio format).
output: The flat program playlist of v5: contiguous items on one program axis; Ton = picture (Base) + A1, Off = no picture + A1, a cover = picture (Cover) + A2 over the A1 of its segment; one timebase, validated routes and lengths; frame windows and transient cover overlays of it. Missing facts are errors, never stand-in formats.
